compatibility.api: API 1.3.0 keeps this component version: this upcoming release changes no public HTTP catalog route, parameter, response schema or legacy admission limit.
compatibility.mcp: MCP 1.3.1 keeps this component version: its four anonymous read-only tools, schemas and admission are unchanged.
compatibility.sdk: SDK 0.3.3 is a planned package patch: public methods, types, dependencies and runtime behavior are unchanged from published SDK 0.3.2. Its bundled release metadata records this upcoming 2026-11-16-ucp-exact-admission ID with UCP adapter 1.0.1, because published 0.3.2 archives carry the 2026-11-17-installed-service-packaging metadata. Both compatibility packages are staged as 0.3.3 and pin exactly @namegarage/sdk 0.3.3. Until this release is published, SDK 0.3.2 and its compatibility packages remain the installable version. Published 0.3.0, 0.3.1 and 0.3.2 archives and tags remain immutable and keep the same public methods.
compatibility.skill: Skill 1.3.3 is planned to change only the two exact SDK install pins from published skill 1.3.2's SDK 0.3.2 to SDK 0.3.3; the rest of SKILL.md is unchanged. The companion release.json records this upcoming release ID; skill_sha256 fingerprints SKILL.md alone. Public read-only catalog, A2A and UCP guidance and the MIT-0 license are unchanged. Until this release is published, skill 1.3.2 remains the installable version; published 1.3.0, 1.3.1 and 1.3.2 artifacts and tags remain immutable.
compatibility.a2a: A2A 1.0.0 keeps this component version: no transport, admission or skill change.
compatibility.website: Website 1.2.1 keeps its functional version: catalog files, snapshots and public read contracts retain their behavior. Agent install examples keep showing published SDK 0.3.2 and skill 1.3.2 until this release is verified and published.
compatibility.ucp: Adapter version 1.0.1 is reserved for the upcoming exact-admission patch. Protocol revision 2026-08-25, its three capabilities, the catalog operations, the permalink path and their request and response schemas keep the published mapping. Installed adapter 1.0.0 continues to serve the single configured signed platform with its existing peer, rate and admission settings until reviewed 1.0.1 source is merged, deployed and verified. This record changes no peer, quota or capacity setting.
